paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam a, lunggulhtak a, atup tengteng ahih khit vek nung in,
heading: Solomon Kiang Ah Pathian Akilak Nawn / (2 Kro 7.11-22)

paite: Gibeon khua a, akiang a, akilak bang in TOUPA Solomon kiang ah ahong kilak nawn hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na thumna leh na ngetna ka ma a na hon tutte ka na ngaikhia hi. Na inn lam tangtawn a ka min omna ding in ka hihsiangthouta hi. Ka mit leh ka lungtang huai ah tangtawn in a-omta ding hi.
Nang leng thu ka hon piak peuhmah bang a hih dia na pa David a om bang, lungtang hoihtak pu leh lungsim diktak pu a ka mitmuh a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuih gigeleh,
Israelte tung ah na gam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding; na pa David kiang a, Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a ka na chiamsa bang in.
Himahleh nang hiam na suante hiam in na hon zuih uh kiksan a, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte leh ka hon theihsakte pom lou a, pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh,

gam ka piak a pan Israelte ka hihmang dia; hiai inn ka min a dia ka hihsiangthousa ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding. Huchi in namte lak ah enghouna leh aselam gentehna in Israel zat ahong hi ding.
Hiai inn sang tawkleh leng, akiang a pai peuhmah in lamdang sa in amuk uh ahum ding ua, bangziak a TOUPA'N hiai gam leh hiai inn hichi tel a hih adiam aw? achi ding uh.

Mite'n TOUPA a Pathian uh, apute uh Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa apaisan ua, pathian dangte alet ua, abiak ua, a-nnate uh asep ziak uh ahi. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atungsakta hi, chi in adawng ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon inn nihte; TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei nung in,
heading: Solomon Leh Hiram Kithukimna / (2 Kro 8.1,2)

paite: Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon sidar singte, meilah singte leh dangka-engte akul teng atupsak vek ahi, kumpipa Solomon in Galili gam a khua sawmnih Hiram apia hi.
Solomon in apiak khuate en ding in Tura a pan Hiram apawtkhia a; ava en a himahleh alungtung kei.
Ama'n, unaupa aw, hiai na hon kho piakte bangchibang khua amaizen ua? achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in ama'n huai khuate Kabul gam achi hi.
Hiram in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih kumpipa akhak hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in phutluih nasem pawl abawl nangawn hiai ahi: TOUPA' inn leh amah inn lam ding leh Millo, Jerusalem kulh, Hazor khua, Meggiddo khua leh Gezer khuate bawl ding in ahi.
heading: Solomon Sepkhiak Dangte / (2 Kro 8.3-18)

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ahohtou a, Gezer khua ava la a, ahal a, huai khua a teng Kanaante athat a, atanu Solomon zi thilpiak in ana pe khinta ngal a.
Solomon in Gezer, Beth-horon khangnungzaw,
Baalath leh Israel gamdai a Tadmor khuate,
Solomon in thil koihkhawmna khua aneih tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, Jerusalem khua leh Lebanon a vaihawmna gamsung pumpi Solomon in lunggulhtak a bawl atup tengteng abawl hi.
Israel suante hilou, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte leh Jebus omsun tengtengte;
asuan uh, huai gam a om lai Israel suante'n ahihman zoh vek theihlouhte lak ah Solomon in sikha, phutluih nasem pawl abawl a, tuni tan in asem lai uhi.
Israel suante bel Solomon in sikha in abawl kei. Galdou mite, a-intekpate, amiliante, asepaih heutute, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuang pawl heutute ahi zaw uh.
Hiaite Solomon nasep tung a heutu tuam, zanga-le-sawmnga, nasep veng mite ahi uh.
Himahleh Pharaoh tanu bel David khopi a pan, Solomon in alamsak ama inn ah apaitou hi. Huchi in Solomon in Millo abawl hi.
Solomon in TOUPA a dia abawl maitam ah kum teng in thumvei halmang thillat leh kilemna thillat alan a, TOUPA ma a maitam ah gimlimte ahal hi. Huchi in inn alamzouta hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in Edom gam a Tuipi San gei Eloth chin a om Ezion-geber mun ah longhon abawl hi.
Hiram in asikha long mite, tuipi a kiseksa, long a Solomon sikhate kiang ah asawl hi.
Huai mite Ophir ah ava hoh ua, dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnih ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang hon tun uhi.
